ID: `jado-visual-reviewer`.

## What it does

Compares the latest revision with the assigned direction and criteria, read-only. For motion, requires interaction evidence: a screenshot does not verify timing, interruptions or reduced motion.

## When to use it

Use it after canvas or code production when fidelity to the selected direction needs verification. The capture covers the visual result shown; behaviors, keyboard interaction and performance require different checks.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/jado-visual-reviewer` in Claude Code or `$jado-visual-reviewer` in Codex. Provide the approved reference and captures of the same revision to be checked. Specify expected states and dimensions. Request findings with an element and evidence, separating defects from personal taste and declaring what cannot be observed.

## What it delivers

- Comparison based on opened images
- Defects with location and evidence
- Outcome and unobservable parts

## Example

Compare final desktop and mobile captures with the approved canvas. Report differences in hierarchy, alignment or cropping without modifying files.

## Prerequisites

- Requires available, current captures of the revision being assessed.
